finding: A profile visit converts only when the profile continues what the visitor came for: pins that prove the follow reason, a bio that says what arrives and when, and a caption that names the newsletter step. With no pins, no highlights and no caption naming the newsletter, 251 visits gave 2 link taps even with a working tagged subscribe link.

evidence.result: Bio link opened /subscribe with utm_content=bio intact; 0 pinned posts, 0 highlights; 0 of 16 captions since 26 Oct named the newsletter; 2 external link taps in 30 days. Changed 19 Nov: bio follow reason saved and read back; the newsletter line saved on the Claude Duet Reel and held on the two boosted posts (the edit did not persist); Krish pinned three posts in the app, not yet visible on desktop.

revisit_when: 26 Nov 2026, seven days after the fix: link taps per 100 organic profile visits against experiment ig-profile-follow-reason's bar of 5.
